facts.statement: Wrapper constructor forbids NONE, takes global graph pool, optional graph options, independent enable_super_kernel, enable_enpu/use_eagle and update_stream, initializes backend None and descriptor-keyed entries. These fields are not all implied by saved enable_npugraph_ex or enable_static_kernel.

Runtime NONE/mode mismatch runs callable directly; matching mode creates descriptor entry and captures only if entry.aclgraph is None. Capture uses args/kwargs current values; replay reuses graph and returns stored output rather than re-evaluating runtime args/kwargs.
First capture records addresses only for top-level positional Tensor args. Debug replay checks the same restricted list. kwargs and nested Tensor containers are not enumerated by this check.

NPUModelRunner._model_forward builds model_inputs dict and partial(self.model,**model_inputs), then calls run_model() with no positional inputs. For this ordinary wrapper call path, captured/debug positional-address lists can both be empty; passing the address assertion does not validate input_ids/positions/embeds/metadata banks.

Before capture, offloader sync_prev_onload completes prior prefetch; join_after_forward joins its copy stream within capture. gc/empty_cache monkeypatch lifetime is scoped by ExitStack. RuntimeError diagnostic branches rethrow, preserving exception chains; no actual failure/upgrade recommendation is inferred.

Optional weak_ref_output may release strong output during capture; current source says it is safe only for last piecewise graph. Workspaces and entry.output are then weak-ref converted. First capture returns output, later replay returns stored output. This describes references/lifetime, not a device-copy or fresh independent result allocation.

Main ENPU flag comes from C getenv ENPU_ENABLE, true only for a non-None case-insensitive true string; enable_npugraph_ex is a different configuration field. No saved ENPU_ENABLE value is attested here.

Wrapper non-ENPU FULL/non-draft-EAGLE replay synchronizes current stream before replay. Updatable path resolves current ContextSource or draft SharedSource; ENPU branch updates then replays, non-ENPU replays then updates. Native parameter-epoch semantics cannot be changed from Python order alone.

Local utils use_updatable_graph requires non-None backend subclass of AscendAttentionBackend. It is not synonymous with every graph/Deepseek backend. The utils hash was computed locally; this turn does not attest its deployed166 hash or live backend class.

Runner generic update_full_graph_params helper is guarded FULL and not capturing and not use_sparse and not use_compress; its ENPU branch also synchronizes. use_compress is hf_config-present+compress_ratios attribute, use_sparse=enable_sfa(vllm_config). Kernel name alone does not bind these live Python flags.

Runner calls generic update before model for ENPU, after model otherwise. In finally it releases an in-flight DeviceMetadataExecutor submission even if forward raises, preventing later submit deadlock. Preserve this exception path in any generation-pipeline rewrite.

Engram routing is prepared before each model replay; capture path uses graph input banks, noncapture path uses current IDs/positions/lookback and device inputs. Existing v30 cache/history/DP participation proofs remain; graph reuse does not make data-dependent routing reusable across iterations.

SMLA plan producer arguments include CPU-derived integer max lengths/request/head/layout fields as well as device length tensors (v37/v42 producer contract). Moving the call into a graph must preserve the scalar argument generation or a separately proved safe fixed bound; updating only GPU tensor contents is insufficient as a generic proof.
